title: κ = 7.77947425336102317479703e-4: restore ten terminal caches in original registers
body:
κ = 7.77947425336102317479703e-4

Exact value: `777947425336102317479703/1000000000000000000000000000`.

Ten terminal helpers blocked by early reads become restored caches in their original dirty registers. The transform retains the early contribution, feeds the pivot after the final centre ERASE, then restores each register using the changed source and its intervening correction. Six helpers finish at rank 5 and four at rank 6. The resulting 146 endpoint-rank reduction is priced together with the five kernel ranks lost by protecting these helpers. Every data endpoint, COPY lifetime, correction and late scalar write remains accounted for.

This uses the immutable source023 orientation construction underlying #338, with fresh protected-kernel selection, 240 early restorations, fifteen ordinary sink removals, ten caches, 115 reorderings and 50 final constructed-frame retimings. It is a separate construction from the selected-carrier sixteen-sink releases. Complete native pricing, rather than a local discovery score, determines the displayed bound.

The final word has 10,005 registers, 8,085 independent dirty helpers, 324,389 ADDs, 47,812 paid calls and rank mass 177,714. At 300 replicas the literal stock is 3,265,110, with 1,918,663,827,000 paid selectors and primitive coefficient 125,785,307,842,628,501. Eight bootstrap levels yield the exact bound above.

The full operational complex supplier remains #327 at `40ed0456ab1990beb3440e61bb883ccf95fdcea4`, with full-fallback saving `779597612622781/10^18`; the bit side still binds. The all-size compiler, weighted selector, common-ancestor chart, restored-row, routing, prime-supply, precision/recovery, complex-symbolic and analytic interfaces remain inherited assumptions. This is a conditional sufficient construction.

Two complete immutable 22-stage replays on Python 3.11 and 3.12 actually exited 0 with matching mathematical certificates. Every receipt hash, both complete five-file producer regenerations, and all 406 committed package files plus the outer manifest matched before push. The source-bound cache stage checks all signed integer and F₂ formal columns, both reflected ledgers and twelve omission controls. A distinct final-word audit checks every F₂ forward/inverse column, arbitrary helper dirt, COPY lifetimes, both reflected paid ledgers, independent exact bank tiling, all 27,836 basis and annihilator minors, and closed-form assembly. The independent final operator replay is over F₂; integer inverse semantics follow the actual signed elementary shears and retain the signed decoder/recovery assumptions.
